roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.summary: Play Chapters 1–5 and their named missions. Meditate at the house during Chapter 1 before leaving that chapter; keep a manual save at each chapter start because missions cannot be replayed. Scan vehicles and explore while travelling, take optional missions as they appear, and avoid cheats, which disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: The 100 percent checklist and challenges
roadmap.summary: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100 percent Completion and clear the checklist. Earlier progress counts; only some collectibles are required, and 70 of 80 challenges suffice. Work through robberies, ranges, drone races, exploration, activity counts and remaining collectibles together where practical.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Finish the character finale missions and remaining Strangers and Freaks strands, then mop up feats and money requirements. Complete A Long Road after the checklist work; Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically when the other trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: PowerPyx's roadmap identifies Vice Got a Price! as the platinum for earning the other trophies, while PlayStation's official entry calls the player a Leonida Legend. The route places it in Stage 3 after the story and cleanup awards; Spin On This! is the preceding character finale, and the platinum completes the list. Keep the in-game checklist open through cleanup, since PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours for the full route.
